name: Italy
notes: Depth: seed. Scope: national, regional and local (register and map to the comune; local sweeping sampled). Covers the May 2024 Manifesto per un'agenda Tax the Rich per l'Italia (134 economists from 50 universities), the May 2026 popular initiative bill 1% Equo (11 first signatories, PRC and Comitato 1% Equo), the 2020 Orfini-Fratoianni budget amendment, the 2024–2026 AVS parliamentary amendments and Restituzione fiscale package, the Fondazione Demo (Felice-Visco) 2–3% Zucman-tax dossier, M5S's financial-wealth levy and parliamentary supporters (Appendino, Tridico), CGIL and Maurizio Landini, Oxfam Italia (#LaGrandeRicchezza), Campagna Sbilanciamoci!, Forum Disuguaglianze e Diversità, Patriotic Millionaires, Carlo De Benedetti, Flavio Insinna, opinion journalists, and a regional/local sample (Bolzano Voto n. 39/25, Lucca). Register: root, Parlamento, 20 regions (ISO 3166-2:IT), 107 provinces/metropolitan cities/free municipal consortia (ISTAT UTS codes) and 7,896 comuni (ISTAT, 1 Jan 2025). Map: ISTAT generalised boundaries 1 Jan 2025, CC BY 4.0.
